text: This report recommends that the name "Travellers' Way" be approved to identify a private walkway adjacent to Wellesley Subway Station. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/

City Council on November 9, 10 and 12, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the name "Travellers' Way" to identify a private walkway adjacent to Wellesley Subway Station. 2. City Council increase the Approved 2021 Capital Budget for Transportation Services, on a one-time basis by $500 gross, $0 net, from the development at 2,6,8 Gloucester Street and 601-613 Yonge Street (source account 220096), for the fabrication and installation of the street name signage (Signs and Markings Asset Management, Deposit Account: 61990060). 3. City Council request the owner and successors of the subject lands to maintain, at their own risk, the street name signage installed under Part 1 above.
